paper_metadata.title: Variational Quantum Factorization (VQF) using Different Variations of Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)

experiments.description: Variational quantum factorization of the bi-prime number 143 using standard QAOA on Qiskit simulation.

algorithm.ansatz: QAOA ansatz with alternating problem and mixer unitaries

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables p0, p1, q0, q1 encode the unknown prime factors of 143; 1 qubit per binary variable.
problem_formulation.objective_function: (p0 + q0 - 1)^2 + (p1 + q1 - 1)^2 + (p1 q0 + p0 q1 - 1)^2, reformulated to a 3-body objective f̄(x) = 5 - 3p0 - p1 - q0 + 2p0q0 - 3p1q0 + 2p0p1q0 - 3q1 + p0q1 + 2p1q1 + 2p1q0q1.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Implicit via clause reduction and minimization of the squared clauses; no explicit penalty weight reported.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Hc = -σz0σz1σz2/4 + σz0σz1/4 + 3σz0σz2/4 + σz0σz3/4 + σz0/2 - σz1σz2σz3/4 - σz1σz2/4 + 3σz1σz3/4 + σz1/4 + σz2σz3/4 + σz2/4 + σz3/2 + 2

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Binary multiplication clauses were derived and simplified using the rules from Anschuetz et al.; the objective was converted to an Ising Hamiltonian and decomposed into RZZ, RZZZ, and RZ gates.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measurement outcomes were converted to candidate factors and counted as successful when their product equaled 143.

speedup_claims.caveats: No classical baseline or speedup comparison reported for this experiment.

experiments.description: Variational quantum factorization of the bi-prime number 143 using multi-angle QAOA on Qiskit simulation.

algorithm.ansatz: Multi-angle QAOA ansatz with separate parameters per gate

hyperparameters.gamma_parameters: distinct γ parameters per problem-Hamiltonian gate
hyperparameters.beta_parameters: distinct β parameters per mixer gate

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables p0, p1, q0, q1 encode the factors of 143.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Same VQF objective as for 143; minimized Ising Hamiltonian derived from the simplified multiplication clauses.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Implicit clause reduction and Ising mapping.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Same Hc as standard QAOA experiment for 143.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Same VQF clause simplification and Hamiltonian construction as standard QAOA.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measurement outcomes were evaluated by factor product; success probability was computed from successful trials.

speedup_claims.caveats: No classical baseline or speedup comparison reported for this experiment.

experiments.description: Variational quantum factorization of the bi-prime number 143 using CVaR QAOA on Qiskit simulation.

algorithm.ansatz: QAOA ansatz with CVaR-based objective evaluation

hyperparameters.cvar_alpha: α < 1; specific values shown in figures but not fully enumerated in text

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables p0, p1, q0, q1 encode the factors of 143.
problem_formulation.objective_function: CVaR is applied to the expectation value of the same VQF Hamiltonian; only the best Nα measurement outcomes are used.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: CVaR selection of the lowest-energy fraction of samples; no explicit penalty term reported.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Same Hc as standard QAOA experiment for 143.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Same VQF clause simplification and Hamiltonian construction as standard QAOA.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measurement outcomes were sorted by energy; only the best α fraction contributed to the expectation value.

speedup_claims.caveats: No classical baseline or speedup comparison reported for this experiment.

experiments.description: Variational quantum factorization of the bi-prime number 291311 using standard QAOA, multi-angle QAOA, CVaR QAOA, and multi-angle CVaR QAOA on Qiskit simulation.

hyperparameters.cvar_alpha: Highest reported success at α = 0.75 for multi-angle CVaR QAOA

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables for factorization of 291311 mapped to 6 qubits; exact bit-variable mapping not detailed in the text excerpt.
problem_formulation.objective_function: VQF objective derived from binary multiplication constraints and mapped to an Ising Hamiltonian.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Clause simplification and Ising mapping; CVaR used for some variants.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Binary multiplication constraints were simplified and converted to a quantum circuit; the paper states a similar decomposition to the 143 case.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measurement outcomes were evaluated by factor product; success probability was computed. Best reported result used multi-angle CVaR with α = 0.75.

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper reports comparative performance across QAOA variants, but no classical factoring baseline or speedup factor is provided.
